message.content: {"draft":"Hypothesis: the 4099-element shape is slow because a single 1024-wide block leaves only 4 programs, underutilizing SMs. Observed contradiction: candidate 1.18us vs compiled 0.895us (ratio 0.76) on [4099], while large shapes win. Fix: use a smaller block (256) for small n to increase parallelism; keep 1024 for large n. Coordinate check: flat offset = i; x[i]+y[i] -> out[i]. Edge i=4098: offset 4098, mask true; i=4099 masked out.","plan":"Output shape equals input shape; contiguous strides all 1. Flat offset = linear index. For n=4099, BLOCK=256 gives 16 programs; last block handles 4096-4098 (3 valid). Mask offsets >= n on load and store. Load as native dtype, cast to fp32, add, cast back to output dtype. Allocate fresh contiguous output via torch.empty_like. No reduction; elementwise. Use BLOCK=256 when n<=8192 else 1024.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def add_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, output_ptr, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):","    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)","    offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = offsets < n_elements","    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offsets, mask=mask).to(tl.float32)","    y = tl.load(y_ptr + offsets, mask=mask).to(tl.float32)","    out = (x + y).to(output_ptr.dtype.element_ty)","    tl.store(output_ptr + offsets, out, mask=mask)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda and y.is_cuda","    assert x.shape == y.shape","    assert x.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)","    assert x.is_contiguous() and y.is_contiguous()","    output = torch.empty_like(x)","    n_elements = x.numel()","    if n_elements <= 8192:","        BLOCK_SIZE = 256","    else:","        BLOCK_SIZE = 1024","    grid = lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(n_elements, meta['BLOCK_SIZE']),)","    add_kernel[grid](x, y, output, n_elements, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)","    return output"]}
